body.purpose: Controls, labels, instructions, and tree rows.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single current-context action such as Run or Commit.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--vscode-button-foreground); background: var(--vscode-button-background); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: background 80ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--vscode-button-hoverBackground); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: default; transform: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition: none; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A supporting action that does not compete with the current primary operation.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--vscode-button-secondaryForeground, var(--vscode-foreground)); background: var(--vscode-button-secondaryBackground); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--vscode-button-secondaryHoverBackground, var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground)); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Icon Action
components.description: A compact Codicon action with an accessible name and tooltip.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Refresh model data" title="Refresh model data"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="currentColor" d="M13.5 2v4h-4l1.47-1.47A4.5 4.5 0 1 0 12.4 9h1.02A5.5 5.5 0 1 1 11.7 3.8L13.5 2Z" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--vscode-foreground); background: transparent; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-button svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background: var(--vscode-toolbar-hoverBackground, var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground)); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-icon-button:active { background: var(--vscode-toolbar-activeBackground, var(--vscode-list-activeSelectionBackground)); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A labeled compact search field for models, fields, and foreign-key values.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: var(--vscode-foreground); font: inherit; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--vscode-descriptionForeground); font-size: 11px; } .ds-input { min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vscode-input-border, var(--vscode-panel-border)); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--vscode-input-foreground); background: var(--vscode-input-background); font: inherit; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--vscode-input-placeholderForeground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Active Filter Chip
components.description: A removable summary of one applied model filter.
components.html: company_type = client
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; max-width: 280px; padding: 1px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--vscode-panel-border); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--vscode-foreground); background: var(--vscode-editor-inactiveSelectionBackground, transparent); font: 11px/1.35 var(--vscode-font-family); } .ds-filter-chip > span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-filter-chip button { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: inherit; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-chip button svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; } .ds-filter-chip button:hover { background: var(--vscode-toolbar-hoverBackground, var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground)); } .ds-filter-chip button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); }

components.name: Model Tree Row
components.description: A keyboard-operable model entry in the Models sidebar.
components.css: .ds-tree-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 16px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; min-height: 22px; padding: 2px 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; color: var(--vscode-foreground); background: transparent; font: inherit; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tree-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-tree-row:hover { background: var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground); } .ds-tree-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-tree-row:active { color: var(--vscode-list-activeSelectionForeground); background: var(--vscode-list-activeSelectionBackground); } .ds-tree-label, .ds-tree-meta { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-tree-meta { color: var(--vscode-descriptionForeground); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Dirty Data Cell
components.description: A model value changed locally but not yet committed to Django.
components.html: AcmeModified
components.css: .ds-grid-cell { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; min-width: 160px; min-height: 24px; padding: 3px 8px; border-right: 1px solid var(--vscode-panel-border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--vscode-panel-border); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--vscode-inputValidation-warningBorder, var(--vscode-charts-yellow)); color: var(--vscode-foreground); background: var(--vscode-inputValidation-warningBackground, var(--vscode-editor-background)); font: 12px/1.45 var(--vscode-editor-font-family); } .ds-grid-cell:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline-offset: -1px; } .ds-dirty-label { color: var(--vscode-descriptionForeground); font: 11px/1.35 var(--vscode-font-family); }

components.name: Operation Status
components.description: A stable text-and-icon status for running, cancelling, failed, or completed work.
components.html: Running query · 12s
components.css: .ds-operation-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 24px; color: var(--vscode-descriptionForeground); font: 11px/1.35 var(--vscode-font-family); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-operation-status svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-operation-status button { min-height: 22px; padding: 2px 7px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--vscode-button-secondaryForeground, var(--vscode-foreground)); background: var(--vscode-button-secondaryBackground); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-operation-status button:hover { background: var(--vscode-button-secondaryHoverBackground, var(--vscode-list-hoverBackground)); } .ds-operation-status button:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--vscode-focusBorder); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Django Shell should feel like a precise instrument built into VS Code, not a separate web application placed inside it. The visual system is calm, compact, and operational: it makes the live shell, current model, transport, execution state, staged changes, and recovery actions easy to scan without competing with the developer's code.

Density is deliberate because the primary users are experienced Django developers working with large namespaces and wide schemas. That density must remain ordered rather than cramped. Stable regions, consistent alignment, semantic hierarchy, and progressive disclosure carry the complexity; decoration does not.

The extension inherits its identity from the active VS Code theme. It does not introduce a fixed brand palette, custom typeface, card-heavy dashboard language, oversized headings, gradients, or consumer-product illustration. Color is reserved for platform-defined actions, focus, selection, validation, and status.
keyCharacteristics: Native to the current VS Code theme and interaction vocabulary.
Dense, keyboard-efficient, and optimized for expert scanning.
Stable under long-running, remote, empty, error, and partially loaded states.
Explicit about execution context, transport, staged edits, and destructive boundaries.
Flat and structural, using borders and tonal surfaces before shadows.
Responsive to editor-group width rather than assuming a full-window page.

rules.name: The Theme Is the Brand Rule
rules.body: Never replace semantic VS Code color variables with a fixed product palette in a user-visible surface.

rules.name: The State Before Accent Rule
rules.body: Use accent color only to communicate an action, focus, selection, validation, or status; never as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Text Plus Signal Rule
rules.body: Connection, execution, warning, and error states always include readable text or an accessible name and never rely on color alone.

rules.name: The Code Is Data Rule
rules.body: Python, SQL, field paths, values, and results use the editor font; control labels and explanatory text use the UI font.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: No active extension surface uses marketing-scale typography. A user should see more useful state, not a larger heading, when space increases.

rules.name: The Workbench Geometry Rule
rules.body: Layout decisions respond to editor-group and sidebar width, not the overall VS Code window width.

rules.name: The Context Never Disappears Rule
rules.body: Narrow layouts may shorten or move controls, but the active model or query, runtime state, primary action, transport, dirty state, and failure state remain available.

rules.name: The Bounded DOM Rule
rules.body: A large Django schema must not produce a DOM or accessibility tree proportional to every row multiplied by every column.

rules.name: The Quiet Plane Rule
rules.body: Persistent regions use tonal surfaces and borders; only transient overlapping regions cast shadows.

dos: Do inherit every surface, text, border, focus, action, selection, warning, and error color from semantic VS Code variables.
Do keep live execution context, transport, progress, dirty state, and recovery actions visible.
Do use Codicons and semantic platform controls before creating a custom icon or interaction.
Do provide keyboard operation, visible focus, accessible names, and live status announcements for every workflow.
Do design and verify wide, split-editor, narrow-sidebar, dark, light, high-contrast, and 200% zoom states.
Do keep the model grid's rendered DOM and accessibility tree bounded for wide real-world schemas.
Do separate functional verification from rendered visual verification.
donts: Don't introduce a fixed brand palette, custom font, gradient, illustration, oversized heading, glass effect, or card-dashboard motif.
Don't use color, a dot, an arrow glyph, or placeholder text as the only meaning-bearing signal.
Don't hide the active model, query, runtime state, primary action, transport, staged-change count, or error recovery to make a narrow layout look cleaner.
Don't leave long-running operations without duplicate-submit prevention, elapsed status, timeout behavior, and an Interrupt or Cancel path.
Don't render every row multiplied by every field for a wide Django model.
Don't make resizing, sorting, expanding, selecting, or opening a model dependent on a pointer.
Don't imply that a staged model edit has been saved before an explicit successful Commit response.
